**Julián Cárdenas** is a professor at the [Universitat de València](https://www.uv.es/uvweb/college/en/profile-1285950309813.html?p2=jucarhe). He teaches artificial intelligence, network analysis and quantitative methods, and researches elites, networking and the use of artificial intelligence in research.
:::
